newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish construction firm prices issue at PLN 12.
newsitem.headline: Polish construction firm prices issue at PLN 12.

text.p: Polish construction firm Energoaparatura SA set the share price of next month's initial public offering at 12 zlotys each, the company said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.

The firm plans to enter the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse after it offers 320,000 shares ex-rights from November 18 to November 22 and 20,000 shares to employees on November 18 and November 19.
The company has said the majority of the proceeds from the issue will go towards purchasing new computers, painting and production machinery and working capital.

The company's main shareholders are The Polish Private Equity Fund I with 21 percent, the Polish Private Equity Fund II with 20.4 percent, the Polish-American Enterprise Fund with 18.6 percent and bank PBR with 15 percent.
Energoaparatura netted 1.8 million zlotys last year on sales of 41.2 million zlotys.
In the prosepectus it said it expected to earn 2.4 million zlotys this year and 3.2 million zlotys next year on sales of 52.2 million and 66.4 million zlotys respectively.
